q24.

```
web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts          # useCreateMemo() mutation, line 178: calls memoServiceClient.createMemo({ memo })
web/src/connect.ts                        # memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport), line 197
proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto           # rpc CreateMemo(CreateMemoRequest) returns (Memo), POST /api/v1/memos, line 21
server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go  # ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo unwraps the Connect request, line 306
server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go      # APIV1Service.CreateMemo builds store.Memo and calls s.Store.CreateMemo, line 70
store/memo.go                             # Store.CreateMemo validates UID, delegates to s.driver.CreateMemo, line 109
store/db/sqlite/memo.go                   # DB.CreateMemo issues INSERT INTO `memo` (...) VALUES (...) RETURNING ..., line 16/41
```

Notes on the pieces:

- The generated Connect client stub that `web/src/connect.ts` binds to is `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts` (schema) with the Go-side counterpart at `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go`, where the procedure path `/memos.api.v1.MemoService/CreateMemo` is defined.
- `store/driver.go` declares the `CreateMemo` method on the `Driver` interface, so the dialect dispatch in `store/memo.go` resolves to one of three implementations: `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go`, or `store/db/mysql/memo.go`. I listed SQLite as the example dialect driver; Postgres and MySQL have the same signature at line 16 of their respective files.
